source: Prefill and decode use the same model but can occupy very different points in the compute-versus-memory trade space. Never transfer a “memory-bound” or “compute-bound” label from one phase to the other without measuring the actual shape and batch regime.
zh: Prefill and decode use the same model but can occupy very different points in the compute-versus-memory trade space.在未测量实际形状和批次状态的情况下，切勿将“内存限制”或“计算限制”标签从一个阶段转移到另一阶段。
